# Yeeflow App Builder 1.15.5

Patch based on final 1.15.4. Normalize responsive Collection search bindings to control.binding, reject conflicting legacy bindings, and verify declarations/consumers in full-app generation. Add opt-in Container/Text badges, native column identity advisories and desktop tablecols traversal, with focused synthetic regressions and three updated skills.

Previously observed desktop badge rendering remains narrow evidence; exhaustive filter options, editable layout routing, mobile fidelity and persistent selection remain open. This release does not change tenant applications.

Source and distribution UI suites passed 29/29 each. Both full-app materialization entrypoint tests passed, including canonical binding, declared variable, fulltext consumer and first-generation preflight assertions. The user authorized direct final release and local installation, continuing the prior RC-skip preference. Packaging and installation results are recorded after execution.

Packaging checks: TypeScript build, core/execution-service distribution validation, skill-reference and MCP integration gates passed. Payload contains 1,839 files, 27 skills, 536 JavaScript files with passing syntax checks and 564 valid JSON files. ZIP integrity and byte parity passed; release safety scan has zero blocking findings. Four extracted-archive smoke suites passed. Marketplace installation is a separate post-push verification and is not implied by these checks.
